notes: Page templates for the printed QuickInk notebook. A scan whose page carries a template mark (or, failing that, the template's printed header words) is filed into folder_id, gets the template's tags, and has its title / date read from the OCR lines whose box centre falls inside title_zone / date_zone.
Zones are normalised page coordinates: 0..1, origin top-left, {x, y, width, height}. They describe where the handwritten value sits, not the printed label.
Both platforms ship hard-coded mirrors of this file; unit tests on each side parse it and fail when a mirror drifts.
folder_id values are the stable ids from workspace_seed.json; tags are tag names (created on demand when missing).
